name: [NEW LEVEL] 🌌 Samsung Galaxy - Prop Hunt 🌌
desc:
Welcome to Samsung’s Demon Hunt ⚡👾
Get ready for a new adventure where you explore, play, and hunt on demons across the Korean streets.

🎮 Work together with other players to find and tag the demons before they get you downed.
🚀 Explore unique Korean locations 
👥 Team up and see who can become the ultimate demon hunter.
✨ Free UGC available when you complete the quest 
📱 Available on PC, Mac, Tablet & Mobile
